description: A dam of water collapses across a 4 m tank, solved on the GPU by GPU FLIP and meshed each frame by the Liquid Surface group. Resolution stays at 64 for now; Speed and Reset drive the water's clock.
name: Water — Dam Break (GPU FLIP)

params.name: Stretch
params.tooltip: Stretch particles along the local flow to join the surface.

params.name: Centre Smoothing
params.tooltip: Move surface particles toward their neighbours for a smoother sheet.

params.name: Fill Pits
params.tooltip: Fill surface dips; distance is measured in particle bins.
